title: Build AI Agents from Scratch: Python, LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP & OpenAI APIs
description: A concise, step‑by‑step guide to constructing intelligent agents using Python and cutting‑edge frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP, and the OpenAI API. Ideal for developers and researchers who want a clear roadmap from fundamentals to deployment.
thumbnailPrompt: A sleek, modern illustration of a digital brain composed of interconnected code snippets in calming blues and greens, with the title text overlayed in clean white typography.

scenes.title: Introduction to AI Agents
scenes.subtitle: What is an AI Agent?
scenes.imagePrompt: A stylized silhouette of a robot head against a soft blue gradient, surrounded by floating data nodes.

audio.text: Welcome. In this series we will build an AI agent from scratch using Python and modern libraries.

scenes.title: Python Foundations
scenes.subtitle: Environment & Dependencies
scenes.imagePrompt: A clean terminal window showing pip install commands for LangGraph, CrewAI, and OpenAI SDK, with a calm green background.

audio.text: First, set up your Python environment. Install the required packages: LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP, and the OpenAI client library.

scenes.title: LangGraph Basics
scenes.subtitle: Defining Nodes & Edges
scenes.imagePrompt: A diagram of a graph with labeled nodes representing tasks, connected by directed edges, rendered in soft blue lines.

audio.text: With LangGraph we model the agent’s workflow as a directed graph. Each node is a task and each edge defines control flow.

scenes.title: CrewAI Integration
scenes.subtitle: Coordinating Sub‑Agents
scenes.imagePrompt: Illustration of multiple small robot icons collaborating around a central command node, set against a calming green background.

audio.text: CrewAI allows us to orchestrate several sub‑agents. We define roles and let them communicate through LangGraph nodes.

scenes.title: MCP Configuration
scenes.subtitle: Memory & Context Management
scenes.imagePrompt: A stylized memory bank icon with floating text snippets, overlaid on a light blue gradient.

audio.text: The Memory Control Protocol (MCP) manages context across tasks. It ensures the agent retains relevant information between steps.

scenes.title: OpenAI API Calls
scenes.subtitle: Generating Responses
scenes.imagePrompt: A code snippet showing an OpenAI ChatCompletion request, highlighted against a soft green background.

audio.text: Finally, we leverage the OpenAI API to generate natural language responses and insights. The agent sends prompts and processes replies in real time.

scenes.title: Deployment & Testing
scenes.subtitle: Running Your Agent
scenes.imagePrompt: A terminal running a Python script that outputs agent actions, with a calm blue backdrop.

audio.text: Deploy your agent locally or to the cloud. Test its behavior by providing sample prompts and observing the workflow graph in action.

scenes.title: Conclusion & Next Steps
scenes.subtitle: Expand Your Agent
scenes.imagePrompt: A roadmap graphic showing extensions such as reinforcement learning, custom LLMs, and multi‑modal inputs, set against a light green background.

audio.text: You now have a functional AI agent. Next, explore advanced topics like reinforcement learning, integrating custom models, or adding visual perception. Happy coding!
